title: The Secrets of the Planet Kamino
front_description: Obi-Wan Kenobi, traveling with an R4 unit, pilots his way to the mysterious Kamino system and soon sets down on this inhospitable, rain-tossed planet. In the stilt-supported city of Tipoca he converses with Prime Minister Lama Su, a tall, rather austere-looking alien. Much to his great Obi-Wan learns that the workers of Kamino have' been developing a massive clone army for -according to Lama Su- the Jedi Council on Coruscant!
back_description: Doug Chiang's production portrait of Kamino's prime minister, Lama Su
